description: Fork of exp201 (nap=8, tph=1024, smooth=True, n_alt=1, regressed to ~2.13). Single change: add a per-block LayerNorm before the LUT, so out_proj sees a stable, unit-variance input distribution. Hypothesis: the LUT's pair comparisons are highly sensitive to absolute scale of the post-SDPA output; without LN the SDPA output magnitude drifts during training, pushing comparisons across thresholds and destabilizing the LUT cell assignments.
